card: E2-S6 [Model] Compare Baseline / LightGBM / RandomForest / AdaBoost / XGBoost (follow-up, not a board card)
no_cherry_picking_declaration: This table reports N, MAE, prediction_correlation and directional_hit_rate for every (model, scope) pair unconditionally -- all 5 models across Overall/LowVol/HighVol -- regardless of which numbers look favorable for any one model.
is_lightgbm_best_declaration: By OOS MAE (Overall), the lowest-error model is 'random_forest'. By prediction correlation, the highest is 'random_forest'. By directional hit rate, the highest is 'random_forest'. These need not agree, and are reported separately rather than collapsed into a single 'winner' -- see README for the honest reading.
